```{r}
#| label: tbl-basetab
#| cache: true
#| cache.comments: false
#| tbl-cap: "Overview"
#| tbl-pos: "H"

tabvars <- names(pop)

tab <-
  tbl_summary(
    pop,
    include = c(-lopnr, -deathcause, -deathdtm, -indexdtm, -censdtm, -dob, -deathyear, -popdtm)
  ) %>%
  as_kable(tbl, format = "latex", longtable = TRUE, booktabs = TRUE, linesep = "") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "scale_down"))

tab
```
